lesson.title: 圆锥曲线的极坐标方程

source.title: Precalculus: A Unit Circle Approach, 4th edition

concepts.title: 焦点—准线与离心率
concepts.summary: 距离比 $PF/PL=e>0$ 统一定义圆锥曲线。

method.title: 方法
method.body: 先将分母常数化为 1；$0<e<1$ 为椭圆，$e=1$ 为抛物线，$e>1$ 为双曲线。

en.title: Focus, directrix, and eccentricity
en.summary: The distance ratio $PF/PL=e>0$ defines a conic.

method.title: Method
method.body: Normalize the denominator constant to 1. Classify by $0<e<1$, $e=1$, or $e>1$.

concepts.title: 极坐标标准式与准线
concepts.summary: $r=ep/(1\pm e\cos\theta)$ 对应竖直准线；正弦对应水平准线。

method.title: 方法
method.body: 准线在正轴方向用加号，在负轴方向用减号，$p$ 是正距离。

en.title: Polar forms and directrices
en.summary: $r=ep/(1\pm e\cos\theta)$ has a vertical directrix; a sine form has a horizontal directrix.

method.title: Method
method.body: A directrix in the positive-axis direction uses a plus sign; one in the negative direction uses a minus sign. The distance $p$ is positive.

concepts.title: 完整圆锥曲线的描绘
concepts.summary: 求顶点、中心、轴和准线，保留负半径描出的分支。

method.title: 方法
method.body: 将主轴角代入；用 $x=r\cos\theta,y=r\sin\theta$ 检查直角坐标式。

pitfalls: 不能把双曲线只画成一支；分母为零的角须排除。

en.title: Graph the complete conic
en.summary: Find vertices, center, axis, and directrix, retaining branches traced by negative radii.
pitfalls: Do not omit a hyperbola branch; denominator-zero angles are excluded.

concepts.title: 由顶点构造极方程
concepts.summary: 使用顶点的实际直角坐标，负半径须先换向。

method.title: 方法
method.body: 设 $r=L/(1+q\cos\theta)$ 或正弦形式，代入顶点求系数。

en.title: Construct a polar equation from vertices
en.summary: Use actual Cartesian vertex positions, reversing direction for negative radii.

method.title: Method
method.body: Set $r=L/(1+q\cos\theta)$ or its sine analogue and solve using the vertices.

concepts.title: 半角、焦弦与旋转证明
concepts.summary: 以坐标代换、三角恒等式和实际线段长度完成证明。

method.title: 方法
method.body: 区分有符号半径与正距离；旋转用旧角 $\theta-\alpha$。

en.title: Half-angle, focal-chord, and rotation proofs
en.summary: Use coordinate substitutions, trigonometric identities, and actual segment lengths.

method.title: Method
method.body: Distinguish signed radii from positive distances; rotation uses the old angle $\theta-\alpha$.

questions.prompt: 识别焦点在极点的圆锥曲线 $r=\frac{6}{2+\cos\theta}$。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 分子分母同除以 $2$，得 $r=\frac{3}{1+\frac{1}{2}\cos\theta}$。比较标准式，$e=\frac{1}{2}$，$ep=3$，所以 $p=6$。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 由离心率判定为椭圆；准线 $x=6$，焦点在原点，对称轴是 $x$ 轴。

en.prompt: Identify the conic with focus at the pole: $r=\frac{6}{2+\cos\theta}$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: Divide numerator and denominator by $2$: $r=\frac{3}{1+\frac{1}{2}\cos\theta}$. Thus $e=\frac{1}{2}$, $ep=3$, and $p=6$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: It is a ellipse; its directrix is $x=6$, its focus is the origin, and its symmetry axis is the $x$-axis.

questions.prompt: 求焦点在极点的圆锥曲线的方程并识别：(a) $e=\frac{4}{5}$，准线 $x=3$；(b) $e=1$，准线 $y=-2$。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: (a) 极点到准线距离为 $3$，故 $ep=\frac{12}{5}$。按准线方向取符号，得 $r=\frac{\frac{12}{5}}{1+\frac{4}{5}\cos\theta}$，为椭圆。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: (b) 极点到准线距离为 $2$，故 $ep=2$。按准线方向取符号，得 $r=\frac{2}{1-\sin\theta}$，为抛物线。

en.prompt: Write a polar equation and identify each conic with focus at the pole: (a) $e=\frac{4}{5}$, directrix $x=3$; (b) $e=1$, directrix $y=-2$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: (a) The directrix distance is $3$, so $ep=\frac{12}{5}$. Choose the sign from the directrix: $r=\frac{\frac{12}{5}}{1+\frac{4}{5}\cos\theta}$, a ellipse.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: (b) The directrix distance is $2$, so $ep=2$. Choose the sign from the directrix: $r=\frac{2}{1-\sin\theta}$, a parabola.

en.prompt: A comet follows a parabolic orbit around the Sun at the focus. At a distance of 60 million kilometers the Sun–comet segment makes angle $\pi/3$ with the orbital axis. (a) Find a polar equation. (b) How close does it come to the Sun?

steps.title: Calculate and reason

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: (b) The denominator has maximum 2 at $\theta=\pi$, so the closest distance is $30/2=15$ million kilometers.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: The source says only “axis of the orbit” and supplies no directed-axis figure. If $\pi/3$ is measured instead from the axis pointing toward perihelion, the compatible model is $r=90/(1+\cos\theta)$ with closest distance 45 million kilometers. That is a different interpretation of the angle.

en.answer: With the angle measured from the opening direction: (a) $r=30/(1-\cos\theta)$; (b) 15 million kilometers. See the axis-orientation qualification.

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: (a) 设观测的正半径分支为 $r=L/(1+e\cos\theta)$。两数据给 $30=L/(1+e/2)$，$150=L/(1-e/2)$。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: (b) 在 $\theta=0$ 最近，距离 $50/(1+4/3)=150/7\approx21.429$ 百万英里。完整有符号极方程还描出另一支，其轴顶点距极点 150 百万英里，故也不减小全曲线最小值。

en.prompt: A comet follows a hyperbolic orbit around the Sun at the focus. At distances 30 and 150 million miles, the Sun–comet segment makes angles $\pi/3$ and $4\pi/3$, respectively, with the orbital axis. (a) Find a polar equation. (b) How close does it come to the Sun?

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: (a) Use $r=L/(1+e\cos\theta)$ on the observed positive-radius branch. The data give $30=L/(1+e/2)$ and $150=L/(1-e/2)$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: (b) The closest point is at $\theta=0$, with distance $50/(1+4/3)=150/7\approx21.429$ million miles. The complete signed-radius equation also traces another branch with an axial vertex 150 million miles from the pole, so it does not reduce the global minimum.

exercises.prompt: 描绘并解释 $r=6/[2-\sin(\theta-\pi/3)]$。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 令 $\phi=\theta-\pi/3$，得 $r=3/(1-\frac12\sin\phi)$，为 $e=1/2,p=6$ 的椭圆。

exercises.answer: 椭圆；焦点原点，长轴方向角 $5\pi/6$。

en.prompt: Graph and interpret $r=6/[2-\sin(\theta-\pi/3)]$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: Put $\phi=\theta-\pi/3$: $r=3/(1-\frac12\sin\phi)$, an ellipse with $e=1/2,p=6$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: The old coordinates are $u=(x+\sqrt3y)/2,v=(-\sqrt3x+y)/2$. Before rotation, vertices are $(0,6),(0,-2)$, center $(0,2)$, and directrix $v=-6$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: After a counterclockwise rotation of $\pi/3$, the vertices are $(-3\sqrt3,3),(\sqrt3,-1)$, center $(-\sqrt3,1)$, and directrix $-\sqrt3x+y=-12$. The equation is $u^2/12+(v-2)^2/16=1$.

en.answer: An ellipse with focus at the origin and major-axis direction $5\pi/6$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason

exercises.prompt: 焦弦通过圆锥曲线一个焦点，焦点将弦分成长度 $r_1,r_2$ 两段（见图）。证明对固定椭圆或抛物线，$1/r_1+1/r_2$ 是常数。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 取焦点为极点，旋转坐标到 $r=L/(1-e\cos\theta)$，$L=ep>0$。两条射线相差 $\pi$，有效有限交点半径均为正。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: $r_1=L/(1-e\cos\theta)$，$r_2=L/[1-e\cos(\theta+\pi)]=L/(1+e\cos\theta)$。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 相加倒数得 $(1-e\cos\theta)/L+(1+e\cos\theta)/L=2/L=2/(ep)$，与方向无关。抛物线中平行主轴的直线没有两个有限弦端点，不适用。

en.prompt: A focal chord passes through a focus, which divides it into lengths $r_1,r_2$ (see figure). Prove that for a fixed ellipse or parabola, $1/r_1+1/r_2$ is constant.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: Place the pole at the focus and rotate to $r=L/(1-e\cos\theta)$, $L=ep>0$. The two chord rays differ by $\pi$ and their finite intersection radii are positive.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: $r_1=L/(1-e\cos\theta)$ and $r_2=L/[1-e\cos(\theta+\pi)]=L/(1+e\cos\theta)$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: Adding reciprocals gives $(1-e\cos\theta)/L+(1+e\cos\theta)/L=2/L=2/(ep)$, independent of direction. An axis-parallel line in a parabola has no two finite chord endpoints and is excluded.

exercises.prompt: 说明习题 50 的结论不能不加分支限制地用于双曲线。比较 $r=15/(1-4\cos\theta)$ 在 $\theta=0$ 与 $\pi/3$ 的焦点直线。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 轴线 $\theta=0,\pi$ 的有符号半径为 $-5,3$；实际距离为 5、3，倒数和为 $8/15$。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 负半径换向，所以有符号倒数的抵消不能当作正长度倒数之和。限定分支时也必须区分端点在焦点同侧所形成的有向关系。

exercises.answer: 两方向分别得到 $8/15$ 和 $4/15$，并非常数。

en.prompt: Show that the result of Exercise 50 fails without branch restrictions for a hyperbola. Compare the focal lines of $r=15/(1-4\cos\theta)$ at $\theta=0$ and $\pi/3$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: At $\theta=0,\pi$ the signed radii are $-5,3$. The actual distances are 5 and 3, whose reciprocal sum is $8/15$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: At $\theta=\pi/3,4\pi/3$ the signed radii are $-15,5$. The reciprocal-distance sum is $1/15+1/5=4/15$, different from $8/15$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: Negative radii reverse direction; cancellation of signed reciprocals is not a sum of reciprocals of positive lengths. Any branch restriction must also distinguish the directed relation for endpoints on the same side of the focus.

en.answer: The two directions give $8/15$ and $4/15$, so the sum is not constant.

steps.title: Calculate and reason

steps.title: Calculate and reason

exercises.prompt: 判断：$r=-4/(2-\cos\theta)$ 与 $r=4/(2+\cos\theta)$ 的图像相同。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 第一式半径总为负。令 $\rho=-r>0,\phi=\theta+\pi$，则 $\cos\theta=-\cos\phi$。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 得到 $\rho=4/(2+\cos\phi)$；两组极坐标表示相同点，故图像相同。

en.prompt: True or false: $r=-4/(2-\cos\theta)$ and $r=4/(2+\cos\theta)$ have the same graph.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: The first radius is always negative. Set $\rho=-r>0,\phi=\theta+\pi$, so $\cos\theta=-\cos\phi$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: This gives $\rho=4/(2+\cos\phi)$. The two polar pairs represent identical points, so the graphs coincide.
